caption: The drawing features a semicircular arrangement of various carpentry tools, all depicted in shades of brown, beige, and muted yellow against a light beige background. The objects are positioned within a stone-like arch form. At the lower left are two large hand saws with distinct handles overlapping each other, and in front of them is a metal axe with a wooden handle. Above the saws in the center sits a square tool, and adjacent to it, a hammer and a wooden mallet cross each other. Near the top right is a wooden chisel, and close to it is a marking gauge. A long wooden plank spans the bottom portion horizontally, and several other tools—a spokeshave, a wooden plane, and a smaller piece of wood—are arranged in front of it. The edges of the composition are defined by irregular, block-like patterns resembling the texture of masonry or stone.
title: Hardware Shop Sign
